lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 暑假快到了，你有什麼打算？最近我和幾個朋友計畫去環島旅行，想跟我們去嗎？
lines.simplified: 暑假快到了，你有什么打算？最近我和几个朋友计划去环岛旅行，想跟我们去吗？
lines.pinyin: Shǔjià kuài dào le, nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn? Zuìjìn wǒ hé jǐ ge péngyou jìhuà qù huándǎo lǚxíng, xiǎng gēn wǒmen qù ma?
lines.english: Summer vacation is almost here. What are your plans? Recently a few friends and I are planning a trip around the island; want to come with us?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一點兒工，多存一些錢。因為畢業後，我打算去法國留學。
lines.simplified: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一点儿工，多存一些钱。因为毕业后，我打算去法国留学。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎng dàoshì xiǎng, kěshì wǒ yào chèn shǔjià duō dǎ yìdiǎnr gōng, duō cún yìxiē qián. Yīnwèi bìyè hòu, wǒ dǎsuàn qù Fǎguó liúxué.
lines.english: I do want to, but I need to take advantage of summer break to work a bit more and save more money. Because after graduation, I plan to study abroad in France.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 你平常下課後就去補習，暑假還要打工，有休閒活動的時間嗎？
lines.simplified: 你平常下课后就去补习，暑假还要打工，有休闲活动的时间吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ píngcháng xiàkè hòu jiù qù bǔxí, shǔjià hái yào dǎgōng, yǒu xiūxián huódòng de shíjiān ma?
lines.english: You usually go to tutoring after class, and you have to work part-time in the summer; do you have time for leisure activities?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 我有空的時候還是會上網看看電影、玩玩遊戲什麼的。
lines.simplified: 我有空的时候还是会上网看看电影、玩玩游戏什么的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu kòng de shíhou háishì huì shàngwǎng kànkan diànyǐng, wánwan yóuxì shénme de.
lines.english: When I'm free, I still go online to watch movies, play games, and stuff.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 你不想去戶外走走嗎？最近有人調查臺灣青少年的休閒活動，發現其中有五分之四的人最常去的休閒場所是「家裡」。最讓我驚訝的是，這五分之四裡面有一半的人，週末都在家上網或睡覺。
lines.simplified: 你不想去户外走走吗？最近有人调查台湾青少年的休闲活动，发现其中有五分之四的人最常去的休闲场所是「家里」。最让我惊讶的是，这五分之四里面有一半的人，周末都在家上网或睡觉。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng qù hùwài zǒuzou ma? Zuìjìn yǒurén diàochá Táiwān qīngshàonián de xiūxián huódòng, fāxiàn qízhōng yǒu wǔ fēn zhī sì de rén zuì cháng qù de xiūxián chǎngsuǒ shì 'jiālǐ'. Zuì ràng wǒ jīngyà de shì, zhè wǔ fēn zhī sì lǐmiàn yǒu yíbàn de rén, zhōumò dōu zài jiā shàngwǎng huò shuìjiào.
lines.english: Don't you want to go outdoors? Recently someone surveyed leisure activities of Taiwanese youth and found that for 4/5 of them, the most frequented leisure venue is 'home'. What surprised me most is that half of that 4/5 spend weekends online or sleeping at home.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 哈哈哈！我就是其中一個。其實，我不但喜歡戶外活動，以前還常跟哥哥去日本滑雪，做一些刺激的活動。我知道運動對身心健康很有幫助，只是最近又打工又補習，回到家就累得不想動了。
lines.simplified: 哈哈哈！我就是其中一个。其实，我不但喜欢户外活动，以前还常跟哥哥去日本滑雪，做一些刺激的活动。我知道运动对身心健康很有帮助，只是最近又打工又补习，回到家就累得不想动了。
lines.pinyin: Hāhāhā! Wǒ jiùshì qízhōng yí ge. Qíshí, wǒ búdàn xǐhuan hùwài huódòng, yǐqián hái cháng gēn gēge qù Rìběn huáxuě, zuò yìxiē cìjī de huódòng. Wǒ zhīdào yùndòng duì shēnxīn jiànkāng hěn yǒu bāngzhù, zhǐshì zuìjìn yòu dǎgōng yòu bǔxí, huí dào jiā jiù lèi de bù xiǎng dòng le.
lines.english: Hahaha! I'm one of them. Actually, not only do I like outdoor activities, I used to often go skiing in Japan with my older brother and do thrilling activities. I know exercise helps physical and mental health; it's just that lately with both part-time work and tutoring, I'm too tired to move once I get home.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 這樣你的體力會越來越差的，應該多出去流流汗才好。下個週末有一場海灘球賽，我們還少一位球員。你有興趣嘗試嗎？
lines.simplified: 这样你的体力会越来越差的，应该多出去流流汗才好。下个周末有一场海滩球赛，我们还少一位球员。你有兴趣尝试吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng nǐ de tǐlì huì yuè lái yuè chà de, yīnggāi duō chūqù liúliúhàn cái hǎo. Xià ge zhōumò yǒu yì chǎng hǎitān qiúsài, wǒmen hái shǎo yí wèi qiúyuán. Nǐ yǒu xìngqù chángshì ma?
lines.english: Your physical stamina will get worse and worse this way; it's better to get out and sweat. Next weekend there is a beach ball game, and we're short one player. Interested in trying?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 我不去！我怕水，對大海還有心理障礙。
lines.simplified: 我不去！我怕水，对大海还有心理障碍。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bú qù! Wǒ pà shuǐ, duì dàhǎi hái yǒu xīnlǐ zhàng'ài.
lines.english: I'm not going! I'm afraid of water and still have a psychological barrier toward the sea.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 你不想克服這個障礙嗎？
lines.simplified: 你不想克服这个障碍吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng kèfú zhège zhàng'ài ma?
lines.english: Don't you want to overcome this barrier?

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 當然想。上個星期我跟一位會衝浪的朋友見面，看他自由自在衝浪的樣子，好酷喔！真希望這輩子也能學會衝浪。
lines.simplified: 当然想。上个星期我跟一位会冲浪的朋友见面，看他自由自在冲浪的样子，好酷喔！真希望这辈子也能学会冲浪。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán xiǎng. Shàng ge xīngqī wǒ gēn yí wèi huì chōnglàng de péngyou jiànmiàn, kàn tā zìyóuzìzài chōnglàng de yàngzi, hǎo kù o! Zhēn xīwàng zhè bèizi yě néng xuéhuì chōnglàng.
lines.english: Of course I do. Last week I met a friend who surfs; watching him surf freely and easily looked so cool! I really hope I can learn to surf in this lifetime.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 這樣好了，等你去了法國，我請我叔叔教你。他是個衝浪教練，我從小就跟著他學。記得有一次練習時，牙齒被衝浪板打到了，流了很多血，有一段時間不敢衝浪。還好，最後總算克服了。
lines.simplified: 这样好了，等你去了法国，我请我叔叔教你。他是个冲浪教练，我从小就跟着他学。记得有一次练习时，牙齿被冲浪板打到了，流了很多血，有一段时间不敢冲浪。还好，最后总算克服了。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng hǎo le, děng nǐ qù le Fǎguó, wǒ qǐng wǒ shūshu jiāo nǐ. Tā shì ge chōnglàng jiàoliàn, wǒ cóng xiǎo jiù gēnzhe tā xué. Jìde yǒu yí cì liànxí shí, yáchǐ bèi chōnglàngbǎn dǎdào le, liú le hěn duō xiě, yǒu yí duàn shíjiān bù gǎn chōnglàng. Hái hǎo, zuìhòu zǒngsuàn kèfú le.
lines.english: How about this: once you go to France, I'll ask my uncle to teach you. He's a surf coach; I learned with him growing up. I remember once during practice my tooth got hit by the surfboard, bleeding a lot, and for a while I didn't dare to surf. Fortunately, I finally overcame it.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 既然你這樣說，下個週末我就跟你去參加海灘球賽吧。
lines.simplified: 既然你这样说，下个周末我就跟你去参加海滩球赛吧。
lines.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ zhèyàng shuō, xià ge zhōumò wǒ jiù gēn nǐ qù cānjiā hǎitān qiúsài ba.
lines.english: Since you put it that way, next weekend I'll go with you to join the beach ball game.

lines.speaker: 尚恩
lines.traditional: 太好了。不過，參加球賽是需要體力的，你最好主動一點兒，每天去慢跑。要是比賽贏了，我就招待你去吃大餐。
lines.simplified: 太好了。不过，参加球赛是需要体力的，你最好主动一点儿，每天去慢跑。要是比赛赢了，我就招待你去吃大餐。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le. Búguò, cānjiā qiúsài shì xūyào tǐlì de, nǐ zuìhǎo zhǔdòng yìdiǎnr, měitiān qù mànpǎo. Yàoshi bǐsài yíng le, wǒ jiù zhāodài nǐ qù chī dàcān.
lines.english: Awesome. However, playing in the game takes stamina; you'd better be proactive and jog every day. If we win the game, I'll treat you to a feast.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 太棒了！我今天就開始去跑步，練練體力。
lines.simplified: 太棒了！我今天就开始去跑步，练练体力。
lines.pinyin: Tài bàng le! Wǒ jīntiān jiù kāishǐ qù pǎobù, liànlian tǐlì.
lines.english: Fantastic! Starting today I'll go running to build up my stamina.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Concede a point politely before introducing a contrast or reservation using 倒是 or 是.
grammarPages.explanation: 「倒是」是副詞，前句「……倒是/是……」表示說話的人認同對方的看法或事實，語氣比較客氣。後句接「可是/但是/不過……」進一步表達不同的看法或保留條件。「倒是」的「倒」可以省略，變成「……是……，可是……」。
grammarPages.pattern: Topic + 倒是/是 + Predicate，可是/但是/不過 + Contrast

text.traditional: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一點兒工，多存一些錢。
text.simplified: 想倒是想，可是我要趁暑假多打一点儿工，多存一些钱。
text.pinyin: Xiǎng dàoshì xiǎng, kěshì wǒ yào chèn shǔjià duō dǎ yìdiǎnr gōng, duō cún yìxiē qián.
text.english: I do want to, but I need to take advantage of summer break to work a bit more and save more money.

text.traditional: 生意好是好，不過一家店一年用掉十萬根吸管，這樣好嗎？
text.simplified: 生意好是好，不过一家店一年用掉十万根吸管，这样好吗？
text.pinyin: Shēngyì hǎo shì hǎo, búguò yì jiā diàn yì nián yòngdiào shí wàn gēn xīguǎn, zhèyàng hǎo ma?
text.english: Business is indeed good, but one store uses up 100,000 straws a year; is this good?

text.traditional: 溫柔倒是挺溫柔的，但是生起氣來就很兇。
text.simplified: 温柔倒是挺温柔的，但是生起气来就很凶。
text.pinyin: Wēnróu dàoshì tǐng wēnróu de, dànshì shēng qǐ qì lái jiù hěn xiōng.
text.english: She is indeed gentle, but when she gets angry she can be very fierce.

items.question: How does 倒是 differ from a direct contrast with 卻?
items.answer: 倒是 politely concedes and validates the initial predicate before adding a contrast, whereas 卻 introduces an abrupt contradiction without concession.
items.wrongTraditional: 想卻想，可是暑假得打工。
items.wrongSimplified: 想却想，可是暑假得打工。

right.traditional: 想倒是想，可是暑假得打工。
right.simplified: 想倒是想，可是暑假得打工。
right.pinyin: Xiǎng dàoshì xiǎng, kěshì shǔjià děi dǎgōng.
right.english: I do want to, but I must work over the summer.

items.question: Can 倒 be omitted in the ……倒是/是…… pattern?
items.answer: Yes, 倒 can be omitted, yielding the identical concession pattern ……是……，可是/但是/不過…….
items.wrongTraditional: 這家店是好，所以耗費吸管很多。
items.wrongSimplified: 这家店是好，所以耗费吸管很多。

right.traditional: 這家店好是好，不過耗費吸管很多。
right.simplified: 这家店好是好，不过耗费吸管很多。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn hǎo shì hǎo, búguò hàofèi xīguǎn hěn duō.
right.english: This shop is good indeed, but it consumes many straws.

questions.prompt: Choose the natural completion for polite concession:
questions.correctFeedback: 好看倒是好看 politely validates that it's good before stating the drawback.
questions.repairFeedback: 倒是 concedes the quality before the contrast with 不過.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express fractions and percentages correctly with the whole preceding the part.
grammarPages.explanation: 「X分之Y」用來表示分數或百分比。X代表整體（分母），Y代表部分（分子）。中文的順序是先說整體，再說「分之」，最後說部分。例如：三分之二（2/3）、百分之五十（50%）。

text.traditional: 發現其中有五分之四的人最常去的休閒場所是「家裡」。
text.simplified: 发现其中有五分之四的人最常去的休闲场所是「家里」。
text.pinyin: Fāxiàn qízhōng yǒu wǔ fēn zhī sì de rén zuì cháng qù de xiūxián chǎngsuǒ shì 'jiālǐ'.
text.english: Found that among them, four-fifths of people had 'home' as their most frequented leisure venue.

text.traditional: 在這座海島上，有百分之九十的人會游泳，百分之五十會衝浪。
text.simplified: 在这座海岛上，有百分之九十的人会游泳，百分之五十会冲浪。
text.pinyin: Zài zhè zuò hǎidǎo shàng, yǒu bǎi fēn zhī jiǔshí de rén huì yóuyǒng, bǎi fēn zhī wǔshí huì chōnglàng.
text.english: On this island, 90 percent of people can swim, and 50 percent can surf.

text.traditional: 為了當成功的球員，他每天用三分之二的時間練球。
text.simplified: 为了当成功的球员，他每天用三分之二的时间练球。
text.pinyin: Wèile dāng chénggōng de qiúyuán, tā měitiān yòng sān fēn zhī èr de shíjiān liànqiú.
text.english: To become a successful player, he spends two-thirds of his daily time practicing.

items.question: What is the correct word order for fractions in Chinese?
items.answer: Chinese puts the whole (denominator) first, followed by 分之, then the part (numerator). E.g. 四分之三 is 3/4.
items.wrongTraditional: 班上有三分之四的同學參加了活動。
items.wrongSimplified: 班上有三分之四的同学参加了活动。

right.traditional: 班上有四分之三的同學參加了活動。
right.simplified: 班上有四分之三的同学参加了活动。
right.pinyin: Bān shàng yǒu sì fēn zhī sān de tóngxué cānjiā le huódòng.
right.english: Three-fourths of the students in class joined the event.

items.question: How do you express percentages like 50%?
items.answer: Use 百分之 followed by the percentage number, e.g. 百分之五十.
items.wrongTraditional: 在這座海島上，有五十分之百的人會衝浪。
items.wrongSimplified: 在这座海岛上，有五十分之百的人会冲浪。

right.traditional: 在這座海島上，有百分之五十的人會衝浪。
right.simplified: 在这座海岛上，有百分之五十的人会冲浪。
right.pinyin: Zài zhè zuò hǎidǎo shàng, yǒu bǎi fēn zhī wǔshí de rén huì chōnglàng.
right.english: On this island, 50% of the people can surf.

questions.prompt: How do you say 'three-fourths' (3/4) in Chinese?
questions.correctFeedback: 四分之三 puts the whole (4) first, followed by 分之 and the part (3).
questions.repairFeedback: Chinese fraction order is denominator first, then 分之, then numerator.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express relief that an anticipated outcome was finally achieved using 總算.
grammarPages.explanation: 「總算」當副詞，表示經過一段時間的等待、努力或困難後，期待的事情終於實現了，帶有如釋重負或欣慰的語氣，常用在口語。

text.traditional: 有一段時間不敢衝浪。還好，最後總算克服了。
text.simplified: 有一段时间不敢冲浪。还好，最后总算克服了。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yí duàn shíjiān bù gǎn chōnglàng. Hái hǎo, zuìhòu zǒngsuàn kèfú le.
text.english: For a while I didn't dare to surf. Fortunately, in the end I finally overcame it.

text.traditional: 今年冬天半個月在十度以下，今天總算暖和一點了。
text.simplified: 今年冬天半个月在十度以下，今天总算暖和一点了。
text.pinyin: Jīnnián dōngtiān bàn ge yuè zài shí dù yǐxià, jīntiān zǒngsuàn nuǎnhuo yìdiǎn le.
text.english: This winter temperatures were below 10 degrees for half a month; today it's finally a bit warmer.

text.traditional: 王媽媽的孩子長大了，她總算能回到自由的生活了。
text.simplified: 王妈妈的孩子长大了，她总算能回到自由的生活了。
text.pinyin: Wáng māma de háizi zhǎngdà le, tā zǒngsuàn néng huí dào zìyóu de shēnghuó le.
text.english: Mother Wang's children grew up; she can finally return to a free lifestyle.

items.question: What emotional tone distinguishes 總算 from 終於?
items.answer: 總算 expresses emotional relief and reassurance after a long wait, effort, or difficulty.
items.wrongTraditional: 公車總是來了，真讓人放心。
items.wrongSimplified: 公车总是来了，真让人放心。

right.traditional: 公車總算來了，真讓人放心。
right.simplified: 公车总算来了，真让人放心。
right.pinyin: Gōngchē zǒngsuàn lái le, zhēn ràng rén fàngxīn.
right.english: The bus finally came at long last; what a relief.

items.question: Can 總算 be used for habitual recurring events?
items.answer: No. 總算 marks the long-awaited culmination of a process, not a habitual action like 總是.
items.wrongTraditional: 他總算每天早上六點起床運動。
items.wrongSimplified: 他总算每天早上六点起床运动。

right.traditional: 他總是每天早上六點起床運動。
right.simplified: 他总是每天早上六点起床运动。
right.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì měitiān zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng yùndòng.
right.english: He always gets up at six in the morning to exercise.

questions.prompt: Express relief that something long waited for arrived:
questions.correctFeedback: 總算停了 conveys heartfelt relief after waiting all day.
questions.repairFeedback: 總算 expresses relief after a long period of waiting.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Propose an action or suggestion based on an established fact using 既然……就…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「既然」當連詞，放在前句句首，引出已經發生、確定或被接受的事實。「就」放在後句，引出說話者對該事實提出的主觀建議、看法或結論。
grammarPages.pattern: 既然 + Established Fact，(Subject) + 就 + Suggestion / Conclusion

text.traditional: 既然你這樣說，下個週末我就跟你去參加海灘球賽吧。
text.simplified: 既然你这样说，下个周末我就跟你去参加海滩球赛吧。
text.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ zhèyàng shuō, xià ge zhōumò wǒ jiù gēn nǐ qù cānjiā hǎitān qiúsài ba.
text.english: Since you put it that way, next weekend I'll go with you to join the beach ball game.

text.traditional: 逛夜市好是好，可是我累了。既然這樣，我們先回家休息好了。
text.simplified: 逛夜市好是好，可是我累了。既然这样，我们先回家休息好了。
text.pinyin: Guàng yèshì hǎo shì hǎo, kěshì wǒ lèi le. Jìrán zhèyàng, wǒmen xiān huí jiā xiūxi hǎo le.
text.english: Visiting the night market is fine, but I'm tired. In that case, let's just go home and rest first.

text.traditional: 既然你覺得這份工作不能發揮實力，就換個工作吧。
text.simplified: 既然你觉得这份工作不能发挥实力，就换个工作吧。
text.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ juéde zhè fèn gōngzuò bùnéng fāhuī shílì, jiù huàn ge gōngzuò ba.
text.english: Since you feel this job doesn't let you use your abilities, then change jobs.

items.question: How does 既然 differ from 如果 / 要是?
items.answer: 既然 introduces an acknowledged fact or confirmed reality ('since'), while 如果 introduces an uncertain hypothesis ('if').
items.wrongTraditional: 如果下雨了，我們就留在家裡吧。
items.wrongSimplified: 如果下雨了，我们就留在家里吧。

right.traditional: 既然下雨了，我們就留在家裡吧。
right.simplified: 既然下雨了，我们就留在家里吧。
right.pinyin: Jìrán xiàyǔ le, wǒmen jiù liú zài jiā lǐ ba.
right.english: Since it is raining, let's just stay home.

items.question: What adverb typically introduces the consequence after 既然?
items.answer: 就 is used in the second clause to propose an action, deduction, or response.
items.wrongTraditional: 既然你這樣說，而且去參加比賽吧。
items.wrongSimplified: 既然你这样说，而且去参加比赛吧。

right.traditional: 既然你這樣說，就去參加比賽吧。
right.simplified: 既然你这样说，就去参加比赛吧。
right.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ zhèyàng shuō, jiù qù cānjiā bǐsài ba.
right.english: Since you put it that way, then go join the competition.

questions.prompt: Select the sentence with a verified fact followed by a recommendation:
questions.correctFeedback: 既然 recognizes the existing fact and provides the premise for departing.
questions.repairFeedback: 既然 pairs with 就 to deduce a proposal from an acknowledged fact.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 張文華在老闆的眼中，是個認真又有能力的好員工，所以進公司不久就當上了經理。他不僅要管理各部門的員工，還得負責市場研究、規劃新產品的設計等，經常因為加班而犧牲週末的休息時間；手機裡記著每天的行程和大大小小的事情，甚至連客人的興趣都記在上面。他的生活裡好像只有工作，分分秒秒都很緊張。
lines.simplified: 张文华在老板的眼中，是个认真又有能力的好员工，所以进公司不久就当上了经理。他不仅要管理各部门的员工，还得负责市场研究、规划新产品的设计等，经常因为加班而牺牲周末的休息时间；手机里记着每天的行程和大大小小的事情，甚至连客人的兴趣都记在上面。他的生活里好像只有工作，分分秒秒都很紧张。
lines.pinyin: Zhāng Wénhuá zài lǎobǎn de yǎn zhōng, shì ge rènzhēn yòu yǒu nénglì de hǎo yuángōng, suǒyǐ jìn gōngsī bùjiǔ jiù dāngshang le jīnglǐ. Tā bùjǐn yào guǎnlǐ gè bùmén de yuángōng, hái děi fùzé shìchǎng yánjiū, guīhuà xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjì děng, jīngcháng yīnwèi jiābān ér xīshēng zhōumò de xiūxi shíjiān; shǒujī lǐ jìzhe měitiān de xíngchéng hé dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqing, shènzhì lián kèrén de xìngqù dōu jì zài shàngmiàn. Tā de shēnghuó lǐ hǎoxiàng zhǐyǒu gōngzuò, fēnfēnmiǎomiǎo dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
lines.english: Narrator: In his boss's eyes, Zhang Wenhua was a diligent and capable employee, so not long after joining the company he became manager. He not only managed employees of various departments, but also oversaw market research and product design planning, often sacrificing weekend rest for overtime; his phone recorded daily schedules and matters large and small, even guests' interests. Life seemed to consist only of work, tense every second.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 除了辦公室裡必要的工作，為了讓生意談得更順利，有時張文華下班以後，還得陪客人到酒吧去喝幾杯。雖然他覺得那裡的音樂聽起來像噪音，但是為了工作不能不去，有時候還會喝得太多。有一次他醉得很厲害，第二天上班時，一整天都覺得精神很差，一直到了第三天才慢慢恢復。
lines.simplified: 除了办公室里必要的工作，为了让生意谈得更顺利，有时张文华下班以后，还得陪客人到酒吧去喝几杯。虽然他觉得那里的音乐听起来像噪音，但是为了工作不能不去，有时候还会喝得太多。有一次他醉得很厉害，第二天上班时，一整天都觉得精神很差，一直到了第三天才慢慢恢复。
lines.pinyin: Chúle bàngōngshì lǐ bìyào de gōngzuò, wèile ràng shēngyì tán de gèng shùnlì, yǒushí Zhāng Wénhuá xiàbān yǐhòu, hái děi péi kèrén dào jiǔbā qù hē jǐ bēi. Suīrán tā juéde nàlǐ de yīnyuè tīng qǐlai xiàng zàoyīn, dànshì wèile gōngzuò bùnéng bú qù, yǒu shíhou hái huì hē de tài duō. Yǒu yí cì tā zuì de hěn lìhai, dì-èr tiān shàngbān shí, yì zhěng tiān dōu juéde jīngshén hěn chà, yìzhí dào le dì-sān tiān cái mànmàn huīfù.
lines.english: Besides essential office tasks, to make business negotiations run smoothly, Zhang Wenhua sometimes had to accompany clients to bars for drinks after work. Although he felt the music there sounded like noise, for work he could not not go, and sometimes drank too much. Once he got very drunk, felt terrible all day at work the next day, and only gradually recovered by the third day.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 有一天張文華正準備出門上班時，他看到電視上播著新聞，有位明星因為工作太累、太緊張，以吸毒來忘掉痛苦，結果被警察抓了。看到這樣的新聞，他突然明白不能因為工作，而傷害自己的身心健康，所以決定重新規劃自己的生活。
lines.simplified: 有一天张文华正准备出门上班时，他看到电视上播着新闻，有位明星因为工作太累、太紧张，以吸毒来忘掉痛苦，结果被警察抓了。看到这样的新闻，他突然明白不能因为工作，而伤害自己的身心健康，所以决定重新规划自己的生活。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān Zhāng Wénhuá zhèng zhǔnbèi chūmén shàngbān shí, tā kàndào diànshì shàng bōzhe xīnwén, yǒu wèi míngxīng yīnwèi gōngzuò tài lèi, tài jǐnzhāng, yǐ xīdú lái wàngdiào tòngkǔ, jiéguǒ bèi jǐngchá zhuā le. Kàndào zhèyàng de xīnwén, tā tūrán míngbai bùnéng yīnwèi gōngzuò, ér shānghài zìjǐ de shēnxīn jiànkāng, suǒyǐ juédìng chóngxīn guīhuà zìjǐ de shēnghuó.
lines.english: One day as Zhang Wenhua was just preparing to leave for work, he saw news on TV: a celebrity, overwhelmed and stressed from work, took drugs to forget the pain and was arrested by police. Seeing this news, he suddenly realized one must not harm mental and physical health for work, so he decided to replan his life.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 從那天起，他試著把年輕時的興趣找回來，開始玩音響、參加樂團。一放假就帶著孩子去海邊釣魚、去山上摘水果，也開始在院子裡種起花來了。當開花的季節到了，家人就會在院子裡看看花、聊聊天。上個星期他的樂團辦了一場戶外演唱會，好多人都去看他們的表演，結束時還放了煙火，熱鬧得不得了。
lines.simplified: 从那天起，他试着把年轻时的兴趣找回来，开始玩音响、参加乐团。一放假就带着孩子去海边钓鱼、去山上摘水果，也开始在院子里种起花来了。当开花的季节到了，家人就会在院子里看看花、聊聊天。上个星期他的乐团办了一场户外演唱会，好多人都去看他们的表演，结束时还放了烟火，热闹得不得了。
lines.pinyin: Cóng nà tiān qǐ, tā shìzhe bǎ niánqīng shí de xìngqù zhǎo huílái, kāishǐ wán yīnxiǎng, cānjiā yuètuán. Yí fàngjià jiù dàizhe háizi qù hǎibiān diàoyú, qù shānshàng zhāi shuǐguǒ, yě kāishǐ zài yuànzi lǐ zhòng qǐ huā lái le. Dāng kāihuā de jìjié dào le, jiārén jiù huì zài yuànzi lǐ kànkan huā, liáoliao tiān. Shàng ge xīngqī tā de yuètuán bàn le yì chǎng hùwài yǎnchànghuì, hǎo duō rén dōu qù kàn tāmen de biǎoyǎn, jiéshù shí hái fàng le yānhuǒ, rènào de bùdéliǎo.
lines.english: From that day on, he tried to recover hobbies from his youth, taking up audio gear and joining a band. On holidays he took his children fishing by the sea and fruit-picking on the mountain, and started planting flowers in the yard. When blooming season arrived, the family would enjoy the flowers and chat in the yard. Last week his band held an outdoor concert, crowds came to watch, and fireworks went off at the finale—it was lively beyond words.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 過去張文華滿腦子都是工作，現在下班時間快到時，就趕快把必要的工作完成，馬上離開辦公室。對他來說，生活的意義不再只是工作，「休息是為了走更遠的路」，努力往前走時，也要停下來看看周圍美麗的風景。
lines.simplified: 过去张文华满脑子都是工作，现在下班时间快到时，就赶快把必要的工作完成，马上离开办公室。对他来说，生活的意义不再只是工作，「休息是为了走更远的路」，努力往前走时，也要停下来看看周围美丽的风景。
lines.pinyin: Guòqù Zhāng Wénhuá mǎnnǎozǐ dōu shì gōngzuò, xiànzài xiàbān shíjiān kuài dào shí, jiù gǎnkuài bǎ bìyào de gōngzuò wánchéng, mǎshàng líkāi bàngōngshì. Duì tā lái shuō, shēnghuó de yìyì bú zài zhǐshì gōngzuò, 'xiūxi shì wèile zǒu gèng yuǎn de lù', nǔlì wǎng qián zǒu shí, yě yào tíng xiàlai kànkan zhōuwéi měilì de fēngjǐng.
lines.english: In the past Zhang Wenhua's head was full of work; now when off-work time nears, he quickly finishes essential tasks and leaves the office immediately. To him, life's meaning is no longer just work: 'rest is for walking a longer road'; while striving forward, one must also pause to take in the beautiful scenery around.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Frame perspective or experience within a process or scope using 在……中.
grammarPages.explanation: 「在……中」用來表示處於某個情況、過程或範圍裡面。「在」的後面接名詞短語或情境短語，表示「在某人的眼光/心意裡」、「在某個活動/環境裡」。

text.traditional: 張文華在老闆的眼中，是個認真又有能力的好員工。
text.simplified: 张文华在老板的眼中，是个认真又有能力的好员工。
text.pinyin: Zhāng Wénhuá zài lǎobǎn de yǎn zhōng, shì ge rènzhēn yòu yǒu nénglì de hǎo yuángōng.
text.english: In the boss's eyes, Zhang Wenhua was a conscientious and capable good employee.

text.traditional: 我每天回家吃晚飯，因為在我心中，家人比什麼都重要。
text.simplified: 我每天回家吃晚饭，因为在我心中，家人比什么都重要。
text.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān huí jiā chī wǎnfàn, yīnwèi zài wǒ xīn zhōng, jiārén bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào.
text.english: I go home every day for dinner because in my heart, family is more important than anything.

text.traditional: 在會議報告中的第十頁，你翻一下應該就看得到。
text.simplified: 在会议报告中的第十页，你翻一下应该就看得到。
text.pinyin: Zài huìyì bàogào zhōng de dì-shí yè, nǐ fān yíxià yīnggāi jiù kàn de dào.
text.english: On page 10 of the meeting report, if you flip there you should see it.

items.question: What does 在……中 convey compared to 在……上?
items.answer: 在……中 scopes within an ongoing process, collective category, or mental perspective ('in the eyes/heart of'), whereas 在……上 marks a specific field or topical domain.
items.wrongTraditional: 他在老闆的眼上是個認真的好員工。
items.wrongSimplified: 他在老板的眼上是个认真的好员工。

right.traditional: 他在老闆的眼中是個認真的好員工。
right.simplified: 他在老板的眼中是个认真的好员工。
right.pinyin: Tā zài lǎobǎn de yǎn zhōng shì ge rènzhēn de hǎo yuángōng.
right.english: In his boss's eyes, he is a conscientious and good employee.

items.question: Can 在……中 frame an ongoing life period or experience?
items.answer: Yes, such as 在留學生活中 or 在每天忙碌的工作中.
items.wrongTraditional: 在留學生活上，他學會了獨立生活。
items.wrongSimplified: 在留学生活上，他学会了独立生活。

right.traditional: 在留學生活中，他學會了獨立生活。
right.simplified: 在留学生活中，他学会了独立生活。
right.pinyin: Zài liúxué shēnghuó zhōng, tā xuéhuì le dúlì shēnghuó.
right.english: During his study abroad life, he learned to live independently.

questions.prompt: Select the phrase meaning 'in the boss's eyes':
questions.correctFeedback: 在……眼中 / 中 captures perspective within someone's view.
questions.repairFeedback: 在 pairs with 中 / 眼中 to mark a perspective or situation.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Cannot But / Have No Choice But To
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Distinguish between moral necessity (不能不) and reluctant helplessness (不得不).
grammarPages.explanation: 「不能不」表示應該、必須、一定要做某件事，不做不行，側重於責任或道理上的義務。「不得不」表示當事人主觀上不願意，但因客觀條件或現實無奈只好去做，語氣比「不能不」更強，帶有不得已的無奈感。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不能不 / 不得不 + Predicate

text.traditional: 牛先生為了讓孩子有房間，不能不換大一點的房子。
text.simplified: 牛先生为了让孩子有房间，不能不换大一点的房子。
text.pinyin: Niú xiānsheng wèile ràng háizi yǒu fángjiān, bùnéng bù huàn dà yìdiǎn de fángzi.
text.english: Mr. Niu, in order to give each child a room, cannot but change to a bigger apartment.

text.traditional: 今晚爸媽讓我照顧弟妹，我不能不早一點回家。
text.simplified: 今晚爸妈让我照顾弟妹，我不能不早一点回家。
text.pinyin: Jīnwǎn bàmā ràng wǒ zhàogù dìmèi, wǒ bùnéng bù zǎo yìdiǎn huí jiā.
text.english: Tonight parents had me look after siblings; I must head home a bit early.

text.traditional: 我叔叔因為生病的關係，不得不早一點退休。
text.simplified: 我叔叔因为生病的关系，不得不早一点退休。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shūshu yīnwèi shēngbìng de guānxì, bùdébù zǎo yìdiǎn tuìxiū.
text.english: My uncle, due to illness, had no choice but to retire early.

items.question: When do you use 不能不 instead of 不得不?
items.answer: 不能不 emphasizes duty, ethical obligation, or logical necessity ('cannot not do'), while 不得不 emphasizes helplessness and reluctant lack of choice.
items.wrongTraditional: 照顧父母是子女不得不盡的責任。
items.wrongSimplified: 照顾父母是子女不得不尽的责任。

right.traditional: 照顧父母是子女不能不盡的責任。
right.simplified: 照顾父母是子女不能不尽的责任。
right.pinyin: Zhàogù fùmǔ shì zǐnǚ bùnéng bú jìn de zérèn.
right.english: Caring for parents is a duty children cannot fail to fulfill.

items.question: When do you use 不得不 instead of 不能不?
items.answer: 不得不 conveys reluctant resignation forced by external hardship (illness, fire, accidents).
items.wrongTraditional: 房子被燒了，他不能不搬到朋友家住。
items.wrongSimplified: 房子被烧了，他不能不搬到朋友家住。

right.traditional: 房子被燒了，他不得不搬到朋友家住。
right.simplified: 房子被烧了，他不得不搬到朋友家住。
right.pinyin: Fángzi bèi shāo le, tā bùdébù bān dào péngyou jiā zhù.
right.english: His house burned down; he had no choice but to move to a friend's house.

questions.prompt: Choose the term expressing reluctant lack of choice:

segments.hint: had no choice but to give up

questions.correctFeedback: 不得不放棄 accurately conveys the reluctant sacrifice forced by illness.
questions.repairFeedback: 不得不 expresses helplessness in having to perform an unwanted action.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Just Coinciding with / Just About To
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe coincident timing right as an intended action begins using 正＋V.
grammarPages.explanation: 「正」當副詞，有剛好、巧合的意思。表示第一件事剛好準備要做或剛開始做時，第二件事巧合地發生了。「正」後面常接「要、想、打算、準備」等動詞，表示「正要……的時候，巧合的事情發生了」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 正 + Verb (要/想/打算/準備) + Action 1，Coincident Action 2

text.traditional: 有一天張文華正準備出門上班時，他看到電視上播著新聞。
text.simplified: 有一天张文华正准备出门上班时，他看到电视上播着新闻。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān Zhāng Wénhuá zhèng zhǔnbèi chūmén shàngbān shí, tā kàndào diànshì shàng bōzhe xīnwén.
text.english: One day as Zhang Wenhua was just preparing to leave for work, he saw the news playing on TV.

text.traditional: 我正想打電話給小紀時，就接到他打來的電話。
text.simplified: 我正想打电话给小纪时，就接到他打来的电话。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng xiǎng dǎ diànhuà gěi Xiǎo Jì shí, jiù jiēdào tā dǎ lái de diànhuà.
text.english: Just as I was thinking of calling Xiao Ji, I received a phone call from him.

text.traditional: 我正要進電梯時，突然發生地震，還好我沒進去。
text.simplified: 我正要进电梯时，突然发生地震，还好我没进去。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng yào jìn diàntī shí, tūrán fāshēng dìzhèn, hái hǎo wǒ méi jìnqù.
text.english: Just as I was about to enter the elevator, an earthquake struck; luckily I hadn't stepped inside.

words.meaning: I was about to enter elevator

items.question: What is the difference between 正＋V and 正在＋V?
items.answer: 正＋V marks the exact threshold moment or coincidence right as an intention starts (often with 要/想/打算/準備). 正在＋V marks continuous ongoing duration.
items.wrongTraditional: 我正在要出門，你就來了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我正在要出门，你就来了。

right.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng yào chūmén, nǐ jiù lái le.
right.english: Just as I was about to head out, you arrived.

words.meaning: I was about to head out

items.question: What verbs typically follow 正 to express threshold timing?
items.answer: Verbs expressing impending action or intention such as 要, 想, 打算, and 準備.
items.wrongTraditional: 有一天他正已經出門，看到新聞。
items.wrongSimplified: 有一天他正已经出门，看到新闻。

right.traditional: 有一天他正準備出門，看到新聞。
right.simplified: 有一天他正准备出门，看到新闻。
right.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān tā zhèng zhǔnbèi chūmén, kàndào xīnwén.
right.english: One day right as he was preparing to leave, he saw the news.

questions.prompt: Select the sentence describing a coincidence just as you were about to call:

segments.hint: was just thinking of finding you

questions.correctFeedback: 正想找你 denotes the exact coincident moment.
questions.repairFeedback: 正＋想 expresses coincident timing right as you were about to call.
